annotations.title: Space industry job market data for investors

description: Hiring radar is the investor dataset from SpaceJobs.Now. It holds every space industry role seen on an employer's own job board from the first time that board was read: a row per role (posted pay, field, eligible countries, opening and closing dates), daily figures per employer, and a change log. The tool reports current coverage, the available files, who uses it, the price and how to request a sample.
name: get_hiring_radar
